text:
Rep. Chip Roy Press Office highlights repeated calls for border security legislation
Rep. Chip Roy Press Office, representing U.S. Congressman Chip Roy of Texas’s 21st District, issued a series of statements on social media in late June 2026 regarding legislative efforts in the House and his stance on border security and child protection legislation.
On June 29, 2026, the press office stated, "The House has passed Rep. Roy’s SAVE America Act THREE times—and is ready to pass it a FOURTH time this week. The House has acted. Again and again. Where is the Senate?" This post emphasized repeated House action on the SAVE America Act and questioned the Senate's response.
Later that day, another statement outlined legislative priorities: "To preserve our Republic, we need secure borders and secure elections. That’s why we MUST: -Pass Rep. Roy’s SAVE America Act. -Pass Rep. Roy’s Permanent Trump Secure Border Act to codify President Trump’s policies into law."
On June 30, 2026, following passage of the KIDS Act (H.R. 7757) in the House, Rep. Roy's office posted, "Rep. Roy Statement on House passage of KIDS Act (H.R. 7757): 'While I voted against H.R. 7757 – KIDS Act, I appreciate the continued efforts to improve this legislation as we work to protect children from online exploitation, targeting, and abuse.'"
Chip Roy has served in Congress since replacing Lamar Smith in 2019 as representative for Texas’ 21st district and has won consecutive general elections since then by significant margins over opponents Kristin Hook (2024), Claudia Zapata (2022), Wendy Davis (2020), and Joseph Kopser (2018). He continues to focus on issues such as border security and child protection through proposed legislation.
